## PR description
### [Rebase] Rebase to vllm 0.27.0  [labels: ready, high priority]
<!-- markdownlint-disable -->
## Purpose

Rebase vLLM-Omni onto the released **vLLM v0.27.0** (base image `vllm/vllm-openai:v0.27.0`, torch 2.13.0). Beyond the mechanical rebase, this PR fixes every regression the alignment surfaced across nightly builds 2952–2957, grouped below by root cause.

## Bugs found and fixed

### A. vLLM 0.27 API / behavior drift

| Bug | Root cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Every AR/generation stage died at warmup with `TypeError: _dummy_run() got an unexpected keyword argument 'randomize_inputs'` (~20 jobs in build 2952) | vLLM 0.27 added `randomize_inputs` to `GPUModelRunner._dummy_run` and FlashInfer autotune passes it; omni's overrides redeclare the signature | 701bcc68 accepts and forwards the kwarg |
| Code2wav stages died with CUDA device-side asserts (11 jobs in build 2953) | Follow-up to the fix above: forwarding randomization into **generation** stages fills dummy ids with vocab-uniform randoms, which code2wav treats as packed RVQ codec codes → out-of-range embedding lookup at `code_embedding(codes + code_offset)` | dedda28f — generation runner accepts but never forwards `randomize_inputs`; the thinker (a real MoE) keeps randomizing |
| Plain `vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct` crashed in `profile_run` with `TypeError: only integer tensors of a single element can be converted to an index` | Since omni archs unconditionally override upstream registry entries, non-staged vLLM runs construct omni classes; the thinker `forward` always returned a `(hidden_states, captured_hidden_states)` tuple that stock vLLM's runner cannot index | e3efeaaf — bare tensor when no capture is requested; capture only in staged runs (only a talker consumes it, and each capture costs a clone per layer per step); `make_omni_output` accepts both shapes. Verified by a dummy-weight serve counterfactual: fails before, serves after |
| HunyuanImage3 (MoE DiT, TP=4 + EP) failed weight loading with `assert all2all_manager is not None` | vLLM 0.27's MoE oracle requires the EP group's device communicator to carry an all2all manager, which vLLM only builds for groups created with `use_all2all=True`; the diffusion stack's EP group never passed it | c382e801 — pass `use_all2all=True`, version-guarded for older vLLM |
| seed-TTS WER regressed 0.2695 -> ~0.38 (nightly 2946 -> 2949+; median 0.0 — a tail of corrupted utterances) and intermittent `audio content is not same as the text` e2e failures | Two candidate defects landed in the same window. (1) The async-discard reimplementation (59b9e719) seeded `num_stale_output_tokens` in placeholder units while the drain subtracts scheduled-token units; on divergence (spec drafts, in-flight prefill) the leftover counter silently swallowed the new segment's first valid talker frames (hole in the codec stream) or underflowed the drain assert. CPU-proven by scheduler-level tests (e21bffaf). (2) The same window switched CI to the v0.27.0 image (torch 2.13). | c2b65233 fixes (1) — seed from `num_in_flight_tokens` (same units as the drain) at all three discard sites; pre-discard frames drain exactly to zero by construction. **Nightly confirmation is negative for the WER metric**: build 2957 (first nightly with the fix) scored 0.3916, within the pre-fix range (0.3756 / 0.3826 / 0.3936 / 0.5114), so (1) alone does not restore the 0.27 baseline. The WER regression stays open — tracked under Known remaining issues. |
| Multi-replica stage startup died with `Cubin file saved by TritonBundler not found` | vLLM 0.27's AOT compile: replicas of the same stage compile the same model concurrently and race on the shared `VLLM_CACHE_ROOT` | 9c319283 — spawn-time per-replica cache isolation; replica 0 keeps the warm shared cache |
